assurance.runtime_boundary: External trusted runtime; hash-then-use does not isolate hostile concurrent same-user mutation.

coverage.meaning: Declared spans only; overlaps retained; uncovered bytes and semantic completeness are not inferred.

meaning_units.formula:
n0 = text(S)
n1 = pred(n0)
root n1

all.definition: Bind the first variable universally over the declared domain in the body.

and.definition: Both propositions hold in the declared reading.

attribution.definition: First operand is the source of the claim; no narrator endorsement.

belief.definition: First operand believes the proposition; not asserted as fact.

cause.definition: Declared causal claim from first operand to second; not verified causality.

if.definition: First operand is a sufficient condition for the second in the declared reading.

may.definition: Declared permission; no obligation to perform it.

must.definition: Declared obligation; no satisfaction or authority verdict.

only_after.definition: First operand may occur only after the second is complete; no occurrence is promised or authorized.

parallel.definition: Tracks proceed in parallel; no interaction or completion rule implied.

pred.definition: Source predicate applied to ordered explicit terms or bound variables; interpretation is declared.

quantity.definition: Exact amount spelling and unit spelling; no evaluation or conversion.

requires.definition: Second operand is necessary for the first; does not authorize execution.

sequence.definition: First operand precedes the second; no causation implied.

should.definition: Declared recommendation, distinct from an obligation.

some.definition: Bind the first variable existentially over the declared domain in the body.

uncertain.definition: Retain the exact uncertainty qualification on this proposition.

unless.definition: Second operand is an exception to the first; no converse obligation implied.

within.definition: Declared inclusive deadline quantity for this proposition; origin must be explicit or ambiguous.

sources.label: Exact development CLAIM
sources.provenance: Authored development fixture; no model or semantic qualification.
